This node calls Webex Engage Update Conversation API to update the conversation on Webex Engage. While configuring flows in <<prodname>>, you’d need to use this node for updating the conversation.

## Authorization

Refer to section [Node Authorizations](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/wxcc-node-palette#section-node-authorization) for more information.
